title: Sparkly flower pot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='potGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#e07a3f'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#a94f1e'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe97a'>
    <path d='M18 22 l2.5 6 6 2.5 -6 2.5 -2.5 6 -2.5 -6 -6 -2.5 6 -2.5 z'/>

    <path d='M24 68 l1.6 4 4 1.6 -4 1.6 -1.6 4 -1.6 -4 -4 -1.6 4 -1.6 z'/>

    <circle cx='14' cy='46' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='52' r='1.8'/>
  </g>

      <circle cx='57' cy='33' r='5.5'/>
      <circle cx='45' cy='22' r='5.5'/>
      <circle cx='55' cy='22' r='5.5'/>

    <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='4' fill='#ffe23d'/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <g fill='#c98bff'>

      <circle cx='38' cy='35' r='4.5'/>
      <circle cx='29' cy='26' r='4.5'/>
      <circle cx='35' cy='26' r='4.5'/>

  <g>

      <circle cx='71' cy='22' r='4.5'/>
    </g>
    <circle cx='68' cy='27' r='3.2' fill='#ffe23d'/>
  </g>
  <!-- pot rim -->
  <rect x='30' y='56' width='40' height='9' rx='3' fill='#f2924f'/>

  <path d='M33 64 h34 l-4 26 a4 4 0 0 1 -4 3 h-18 a4 4 0 0 1 -4 -3 z' fill='url(#potGrad)'/>
  <path d='M36 68 h8 l-2 22 h-5 z' fill='#f5a869' opacity='0.7'/>
